Hi Elena — great to hear. Quick summary of what we need from vendors to complete procurement onboarding: 

1) Signed DPA (we can do DocuSign)
2) Link to SOC 2 Type II report or SOC 2 summary hosted (we keep links behind vendor record)
3) Current subprocessor register (CSV or spreadsheet)
4) W-9 or equivalent for US vendors (for PO/invoice)
5) Point of contact for billing (name, email, remit address)

Our PO process: once legal confirms the DPA, procurement creates a PO in our system. Please send final invoice referencing the PO number we will issue; invoices go to finance@redwood.com with billing contact cc'd. Typical lead time for initial vendor enablement is 7–10 business days after the signed DPA and billing paperwork are received.

I attached a short onboarding checklist and our standard DPA DocuSign link below. Marissa (cc'd) will confirm legal's side if any redlines are required.

Next step: Elena — please sign the DPA via the DocuSign link and confirm the billing contact. I'll loop procurement once DPA is in.

Thanks,
